purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19301 (FBS-225) driving rcf verify run --artefact through bin/rcf.js over a fixture package repository and a packed tarball, so the FBS-225 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against package target mode.
title: rcf verify run --artefact: AC-bound suites run against the installed tarball, per-AC pass/fail/critiqueOnly/skipped verdicts, suites and install evidence, flag refusals, FBS-219 rules kept, writes only under the report directory, end-to-end Finalise from the tool-written report
